notification_description: Planned maintenance for multiple sites across NSW and ACT
provider_outage_information: Our upstream provider has advised that planned maintenance is being completed across multiple sites in NSW and ACT to conduct maintenance and upgrade capacity across the network. Connections may experience a number of 10-15 minute disruptions during the specified outage window.
